overview: 公司于2026年在马来西亚交易所ACE市场完成首次公开募股（IPO），发行86,700,000股新股。业务板块方面，公告未披露各业务线的具体运营变化。
overview_en: The company completed its initial public offering (IPO) on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad in 2026, involving a public issue of 86,700,000 new ordinary shares. Regarding business segments, the announcements did not disclose specific operational changes for each business line.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 公司于2026年完成IPO并在ACE市场上市。
segments.note_en: The company completed its IPO and listed on the ACE Market in 2026.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE LISTING OF PIONEER HEAT HOLDINGS BERHAD ("PIONEER" OR "COMPANY") ON THE ACE MARKET O
actions.text: 公司进行首次公开募股（IPO），公开发行86,700,000股新股，并在马来西亚交易所ACE市场上市。
actions.text_en: The company conducted an initial public offering (IPO) with a public issue of 86,700,000 new ordinary shares and listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.
